title: The Tithe-Men
text: Men in grey with ledgers under their arms block the road, standing very straight, their faces pale as paper. Everyone pays the tithe, they say. Everyone. Even here. Their ledgers list every House by name, in a hand that does not change.

options.label: The richest House pays them in Essence.

outcomes.text: They count it twice and step aside, and write your House's name in the ledger.
They look at you a long time, then close the ledger and are gone.
